queries.result: First-party results identified the City of Moore GIS Parcel Viewer, the City GIS ArcGIS parcel service, and Cleveland County Assessor GIS documentation. The city viewer links to a public Experience Builder application; the parcel service is described as Moore parcel data from the Cleveland County Assessor's Office.

registryEvidence.custodian: City of Moore GIS publishes the public parcel viewer and Hosted/Parcels service; the service description identifies parcel data from the Cleveland County Assessor's Office. Cleveland County Assessor GIS documentation describes its maintained parcel layer and parcel identification function.
registryEvidence.locality: Moore, Cleveland County, Oklahoma, United States
registryEvidence.scopeNote: A local public parcel service and local assessor custodian are evidenced. The observed service extent is bounded to the published Moore parcel layer; it is not treated as proof of complete citywide coverage for the WUP point.

parcelDiscovery.nativeIdentityObserved: parcelid values were returned for three bounded polygon features; objectid is the service OID and was also observed in schema.
parcelDiscovery.crs: Service layer native CRS is EPSG:2912 / NAD_1983_HARN_StatePlane_Oklahoma_South_FIPS_3502_Feet; bounded GeoJSON response was requested with outSR=4326 and returned longitude/latitude coordinates.

boundedResponse.requestScope: Official ArcGIS FeatureServer layer, where=1=1, resultRecordCount=3, outFields=parcelid, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326
boundedResponse.note: Only safe native parcel identity and geometry were requested. No raw source attribute set was retained. The response indicated exceededTransferLimit because the service has more records beyond the bounded sample.

exactPointQuery.note: The exact WUP point produced zero intersecting parcel features in this service query. The coordinate was not shifted, and this is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

parcelDiscovery.note: Parcel geometry and stable native parcel IDs were observed from the official public service. No sample GeoJSON is retained in the cohort because the bounded evidence remains in ignored scratch storage and retention was not necessary for this research packet.
